faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Aditi Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, and candidates report at 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Aditi Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Vocalist (Department of Music), 1 Assistant Professor - Social Science (Department of Education, B.El.Ed.), 1 Assistant Professor - Education, preferably science education (Department of Education, B.El.Ed.).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Aditi Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 2:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: International Guest House, University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 70 years. Relaxation: Maximum age limit of 70 years applies to retired (superannuated) teachers considered for engagement as Guest Faculty.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligibility as prescribed under the UGC Regulations, 2018, as adopted by the University of Delhi/UGC from time to time. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired (superannuated) teachers may also be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty, subject to a maximum age of 70 years.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selected Guest Faculty shall not hold any other teaching assignment during the period of engagement.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview before the Selection Committee.
